nodes.name: Verify JWT
nodes.notes: Parameters copied verbatim from 'Verify JWT' in Lead Escalation - AI Agent (same public Supabase anon apikey, same Authorization passthrough). A 401 arrives as DATA, not as a failed node (alwaysOutputData + onError=continueRegularOutput), so 'Auth Gate' decides. READ THE COMMENT IN 'Auth Gate' BEFORE WIRING THIS URL INTO SLACK: a Supabase user JWT is the wrong guard for a Slack slash command.
